# Scan fixtures

Byte copies of real FreeCAD exports, used by
`freecad/Shelving/core/tests/test_scan.py` to prove the scanner against
geometry no synthetic test would think to
construct. Do not hand-edit any file here: regenerate a `*.boxes.json` from the
source FreeCAD document with the `Shelving_ExportBoxes` command
(`freecad/Shelving/commands/export_boxes.py`) and copy the result in.

- `real_stair_step.boxes.json`: a stepped unit from a real project, three
  columns of different heights sharing one floor.
- `real_two_units.boxes.json`: two abutting units exported from a loose
  selection rather than a tidy container, so it carries the duplicate-name
  entries a selection reachable by two paths through the container tree
  produces.
- `real_magicstart_f1.boxes.json`: a cabinet generated by Woodworking's
  `magicStart` variant F1.
- `real_notched_panel.inspect.json`: the inspection record of a notched panel
  from a superseded revision, kept as a real example of a solid the scanner
  cannot read as a board. It predates `Shelving_ExportBoxes` and has no
  regeneration path: a now-deleted spike script inspected the panel by hand,
  and the classifier it proved lives on as `container.py`'s box-minus-cutouts
  reason. Treat this one file as a fixed historical record.
